sent_bad: The only performance-related claim is that "Magika outperforms conventional file identification methods, providing an overall 30% accuracy boost and up to 95% higher precision on traditionally hard-to-identify but potentially problematic content such as VBA, JavaScript and Powershell."

It only states that "Google announced today that it's open-sourcing Magika, a new, AI-powered tool to aid defenders through file type identification, essential for detecting malware," that "Magika is already used to help protect products, including Gmail, Drive and Safe Browsing and is used by Google's VirusTotal team to foster a safer digital environment."
The Magika announcement is presented as part of the same program, with the stated purpose of aiding "defenders" and fostering "a safer digital environment."
